digest.component_or_area: git outcome classification and retry policy
key_entities: LOCK, TRANSIENT_FS, TRANSPORT, NON_FF, CAS_MISMATCH, POLICY_DECLINE, DIRTY_WD, UNMERGED, INVALID_OBJECT, FATAL
propositions: Five git classification sites use different verdicts for identical error strings, creating inconsistent retry behavior across store operations
The synthetic rc-124 timeout result is constructed in four places with only one classifier consuming it as retriable, leaving sync._union_merge and push_recovery merges without transient retry
Consolidate git error classification into a single registry keyed by (marker, operation) pair and structural predicates, with classify(result, *, operation) -> GitOutcome as the unified interface
The 'cannot lock ref' string must preserve three distinct verdicts: retriable local lock, non-CAS push reject, and held advisory lock, keyed by operation to prevent re-opening bugs 4afc and ebee
sync._union_merge and push_recovery._merge_with_transport_retry must gain transient filesystem retry through the shared run_git_bounded construction
The invalid-object classification (git write-tree index-entry-missing condition) must remain distinct from FATAL to preserve its index-rebuild recovery path
